module_summary: Source side of a gray-coded CDC FIFO: keeps a gray write pointer, synchronizes the remote read pointer, and derives ready from a full comparison.

anchors.name: wptr_q
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer register, advanced on valid&ready handshake, exported to destination domain

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source write request; with ready it advances the write pointer

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Not-full indication from binary pointer comparison; gates write pointer increment

anchors.name: src_widx_o
anchors.why: Binary write index into FIFO storage

anchors.name: async_wptr_o
anchors.why: Gray write pointer sent across clock domain

anchors.name: async_rptr_i
anchors.why: Gray read pointer from destination domain, fed into synchronizers

anchors.name: rptr
anchors.why: Synchronized gray read pointer used for the full check

anchors.name: wptr_bin
anchors.why: Binary write pointer, incremented and compared for full

anchors.name: rptr_bin
anchors.why: Binary synchronized read pointer used in full comparison

anchors.name: wptr_next
anchors.why: Incremented binary write pointer before gray encoding

groups.name: Write pointer logic
groups.description: Gray write pointer with gray-binary conversions and increment on handshake

groups.name: Read pointer synchronizer
groups.description: Synchronizes remote gray read pointer and converts to binary

groups.name: Full detection and handshake
groups.description: Compares pointers for full, drives src_ready_o

groups.name: Pointer outputs
groups.description: Exports write index and async gray write pointer
